label: Club or society
tagline: For the sports club, the choir or the residents' association.
name: The Club Game

chance.text: Training starts. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
You have to referee the match at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The match starts on {11}. Hurry up. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
It is getting dark. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
You are late for the away game. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You still have to drive to the tournament. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
The referee does not see it. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You walk into the wrong changing room. Go back three spaces.
You get a red card. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The clubhouse gets a new roof. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You forgot to pay your membership fee.
The supporters' coach leaves from {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
Your team wins and you buy a round. Pay each player {currency}40.
A new sponsor signs for three years.
You get to play in {39}. Go there.

chest.text: The new season starts. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The big club fundraiser does well.
You kick the ball over the fence into the ditch.
You get the deposit for your key back.
The chair smooths things over. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You left the cups in the canteen. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You win volunteer of the year.
You find money behind the bar.
You have been a member for 25 years. Each player gives you {currency}10.
Every ticket for the yearly raffle is sold.
You pay for your bar shift out of your own pocket.
The council gives a small grant.
The pitches get reseeded. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
You get a voucher for the canteen.
You sell the old club shirts at the market.

houseRules: Whoever buys a street shouts the club chant.
Whoever throws a double pours drinks for the table.
A committee member may explain the rules once per game.
